article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Angel Montas' 20 points off of the bench helped lead Toledo to an 81-76 victory against Marshall on Saturday. Montas added five rebounds for the Rockets (1-2). Mynor Strong added 20 points and seven steals. Jaylan Ouwinga had 11 points. Bryce Slay finished with 23 points and two steals for the Thundering Herd (1-1). Noah Otshudi added 22 points and four assists for Marshall. Montas scored nine points in the first half and Toledo went into the break trailing 38-27. Strong's 16-point second half helped Toledo finish off the five-point victory. Up next Toledo takes on Wright State at home on Tuesday, and Marshall visits Ohio State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
